title: Faster Compress
description: Prepare context summaries in the background to reduce compaction pauses in long conversations.
liveHint: The defaults are ready to use. Saved changes apply to subsequent preparation and warm-up without a restart.
eagerRatioHint: Default 100: prepare at the background threshold and apply at the next step when ready. The threshold accounts for output reservation and room for background progress.
eagerRatioInvalid: Enter a percentage greater than 0 and at most 100.
warmupHint: Off by default: the next real request processes the new context. When enabled, try an extra request during tool execution without delaying application. Long inputs may compete with the main request.
maxConcurrentHint: Default 1, shared across this host's sessions. Increase only when the model provider has spare capacity.
maxConcurrentInvalid: Enter an integer of at least 1.
warmupMaxTokensHint: Default 1; accepts 1–8. Usually no change is needed.
unavailable: The compaction plugin is not loaded, so settings are unavailable.
saveFailed: Save failed. Check the values; if settings changed elsewhere, reopen this page and try again.
traceTabHint: Show compaction history in each conversation. Hiding the tab keeps local diagnostic recording enabled.
trace.timingHint: Preparation and waiting may overlap; these durations are not additive. — means unrecorded.
trace.nativeTimingHint: Only the native transaction is timed. Any earlier background preparation is not included.
trace.warmupHint: A completed request does not prove a cache hit. Reuse depends on the provider.
trace.warmupError: Warm-up error · summary commit is unaffected
trace.copyError: Clipboard unavailable. Select the text to copy manually.
trace.noSummary: No summary is available for this attempt.
trace.truncated: This excerpt is truncated. The DSH session log retains the complete committed summary.
trace.storageWarning: Local diagnostic storage is unavailable; some history may be missing:
trace.noMatchesHint: Try a different filter or search term.
trace.emptyHint: This conversation has no compaction records yet. Preparation, application and errors will appear as it approaches the context threshold.
trace.retention: Latest 80 · Diagnostics stored locally · Native history survives restarts
trace.explain.preparing: Preparing a summary in the background. It may finish after a normal turn ends and be applied when the conversation resumes.
trace.outcome.waiting: At the safety limit, waiting for the summary
trace.explain.waiting: The step is waiting for preparation. Stopping the turn interrupts the wait.
trace.explain.ready: Summary ready for the next safe step. Retained across normal turn completion and revalidated when the conversation resumes.
trace.outcome.applied: Applied and still in the current context
trace.explain.applied: The checkpoint replaced the selected span; newer messages remain intact.
trace.explain.superseded: This checkpoint no longer appears as a separate message in the current context.
trace.explain.discarded: When compaction is needed, the available native synchronous path is used.
trace.explain.failed: Available error details are shown below. Failed preparation falls back when compaction is needed.
trace.explain.unapplied: A summary event alone does not prove application; replacement records are authoritative.
trace.reason.restart: The process restarted; the old in-memory preparation can no longer be committed.
trace.reason.unloaded: The plugin unloaded or reloaded. A live turn falls back to native compaction.
trace.reason.disposed: The session agent was disposed before application.
trace.reason.idle: The turn ended before the preparation was needed.
trace.reason.cancelled: Preparation was cancelled. A user-cancelled turn does not start fallback compaction.
trace.reason.overflow: The provider reported context overflow; native synchronous recovery is used.
trace.reason.stale: The selected history or pricing changed; the summary is stale and falls back.
trace.reason.not-smaller: The summary did not shrink the context and was discarded before fallback.
trace.reason.no-turn: There is no active turn in which to commit.
trace.reason.summary: Background summarization failed; the original context is unchanged.
trace.reason.preparation: Preparation could not resolve the budget or model information.
trace.reason.commit: Commit failed. Inspect the transaction error; application is not blindly retried.
trace.retryHint: Try again. A diagnostic read failure does not affect conversation compaction.
trace.response.title: Response after compaction
trace.response.unrecordedHint: This historical record has no main-request timing. First-token latency cannot be reconstructed.
trace.response.verified: Verified: this checkpoint was included in the subsequent main request.
trace.response.unverified: No main request carrying this checkpoint has been observed yet.
trace.response.missing: The main request did not contain this checkpoint; response timing was not attributed.
trace.response.manual: Manual compaction: time after apply can include waiting for the next user input; it is not counted as compaction blocking.
trace.response.attemptLimit: Only the latest 8 attempts are retained; first-output metrics preserve their original measurements.
trace.response.boundary: Host observation at the DSH main-request boundary. First output includes non-empty reasoning, text, or tool deltas; per-kind times ignore whitespace-only text. This is not time saved, browser delivery/rendering time, or proof of a cache hit. Tracks the first main request and its retries, not subsequent tool-loop requests.
trace.response.status.ended: Turn ended without an observed response
trace.response.boundaryShort: Measured on the host, excluding browser delivery and rendering. First output may be reasoning, text, or tool deltas.
trace.warmupStaleHint: The route, reasoning effort, or message prefix changed. The old warm-up is no longer considered valid; summary application is unaffected.
trace.warmupPrefix.matched: The main request matches the logical warm-up prefix. Actual cache reuse depends on provider-reported usage.
trace.warmupPrefix.mismatch: The main request does not match the warmed prefix; this warm-up cannot be relied on.
trace.warmupPrefix.not-ready: The prefix matches, but warm-up did not complete successfully.
outputReserveTokensHint: Default 0: use the request or adapter declaration. If unavailable, use native compaction. Set the actual output limit, e.g. 32768 for Qwen. Does not change model generation parameters.
outputReserveTokensInvalid: Enter an integer of at least 0.
safetyMarginTokensHint: Default 4096. Stop growing before the model input limit to await preparation or use native compaction.
safetyMarginTokensInvalid: Enter an integer of at least 0.
trace.integrationNative: Background compaction is inactive for this session; using the native backend. Details:
trace.budgetUnknown: Output reservation is unknown; using native compaction. Set the output reservation floor in plugin settings.
trace.contextUnavailable: Usage unavailable for one or both requests
trace.contextMeasured: Last response before → first response after replacement
trace.contextHint: Input counts reported by the model, including cached tokens. New messages, tool results, or configuration changes may differ between requests; this is observed context change, not exact compaction savings.
trace.summaryInputHint: Includes system prompt, tool definitions, and summary instructions
trace.summaryOutputHint: May include reasoning; not the size of the stored summary
trace.spanEstimateHint: Character estimates are approximate and may undercount CJK text; excluded from measured metrics
trace.reason.retention-limit: The cross-turn retention limit was reached. An older preparation was released; preparation or native compaction remains available when needed.
